# Hello, welcome to my website!

I am Charlotte Voinot, a third (and last) year PhD student at [Inria](https://www.inria.fr/en) in the [PreMeDICaL](https://team.inria.fr/premedical/) team and at [Sanofi R&D](https://www.sanofi.com/en) (Data & Data Science).
I am supervised by [Dr Julie Josse](https://juliejosse.com/) (Inria) and [Dr Bernard Sebastien](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bernard-sebastien-b355a250/) (Sanofi R&D).

My research focuses on **causal inference for time-to-event (survival) data**, with applications to health-related questions.

Feel free to explore the website to learn more about my background, skills, and current projects.  
You can also [contact me](mailto:ch.voinot@laposte.net) if you have any questions or would like to discuss potential collaborations.

# Education

I graduated from [AgroParisTech](https://www.agroparistech.fr/en) (France) and hold a dual master degree in Bioinformatics from [Paris-Saclay University](https://www.universite-paris-saclay.fr/en/).  
Before starting my PhD in April 2023, I worked for nearly two years as a biostatistician in several CROs (Contract Research Organizations), supporting pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device projects.

# Community


- **SFdS · [Young Statisticians Group](https://www.sfds.asso.fr/fr/jeunes_statisticiens/468-les_jeunes_statisticiens/)**  
  I am treasurer and member of the Young Statisticians Group of the French Statistical Society (SFdS).  
  We organized several events during **JdS 2024**, **JdS 2025** and we have organized the **13th and 14th Young Statisticians and Probabilists Day**.


- **Research group · Inria (PreMeDICaL / MissCausal)**  
  Take a moment to explore the work of our team focused on **causal inference** and **missing values** at Inria.  
  This group is led by **Julie Josse** (PI of the PreMeDICaL team).  
  → More information: [MissCausal team website](https://misscausal.gitlabpages.inria.fr/misscausal.gitlab.io/index.html)
